content:
Apple TV has had a stellar year so far, with its latest series, 《Small Prophets》, being hailed as the streaming platform's most impressive new premiere of 2026. Here's what the reviews are saying.

《Small Prophets》has been praised as a "masterpiece" for Apple TV

Apple TV has enjoyed a string of comedy hits this year, including new seasons of 《Shrinking》, 《Ted Lasso》, and 《Trying》, as well as the original breakout hit 《Widow's Bay》, which made a big splash at the Emmys.

Now its latest comedy, 《Small Prophets》, looks set to continue that hot streak.

《Small Prophets》 premieres tonight at 9pm ET / 6pm PT, and the reviews are unanimously glowing.

We already knew 《Small Prophets》 was a hit, as it's one of the rare Apple shows that was picked up from an overseas broadcaster. It aired earlier this year in the UK, and now Apple is bringing it to a global audience.

A fresh wave of reviews further confirms that 《Small Prophets》 is something special. The show is sitting at 100% Fresh on Rotten Tomatoes. Here's what 《The Hollywood Reporter》 had to say:

The review from 《The Verge》 was equally effusive:

Other reviews have called it "a gentle, polished, unhurried masterpiece," with one critic adding: "The interweaving of the storylines is nothing short of genius."

So, if you're looking for another great comedy to binge after tonight's 《Ted Lasso》 Season 4 finale, Apple has you covered.

Will you be tuning in to 《Small Prophets》? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $14.99 per month, with discounts available when bundled with an Apple One subscription.
